home.otherDescription: This website is a personal project to showcase my skills and projects.
home.inviteToVisit: I invite you to visit the different pages to learn more about me and my achievements.

aboutMe.text1: Hello! My name is Loïc, I am currently in the early stages of my 2nd year of a 3-year engineering program in computer science. I am passionate about web and mobile application development, and I enjoy creating innovative applications that meet users' needs.
aboutMe.text2: Outside of my studies, I enjoy exploring new technologies and learning new skills. I am also a big fan of video games, which has inspired me to develop interactive and fun applications.
aboutMe.text3: I am always looking for new opportunities to collaborate on exciting projects and to continue developing my programming skills.

webDev.1: I like to design modern and powerful web applications. My interest lies both in the front-end, where user experience is paramount, and in the back-end, where structure and security play a central role.
webDev.2: I am particularly interested in micro-service architectures, performance optimization, and the implementation of robust and scalable solutions.

cybersecurity.1: Cybersecurity is an essential area for me: understanding how to protect systems, anticipate threats, and analyze potential flaws.
cybersecurity.2: My goal is always to strengthen my ability to think like an attacker to better secure my developments, as well as my personal activities.

hardSoft.1: Understanding the interaction between hardware and software is a passion. I like to explore component architecture, assemble and optimize configurations, while studying how operating systems leverage available resources.
hardSoft.2: This allows me to better understand the performance, compatibility, and to have a complete view of the operation of a computer, from the hardware layer to applications.

fitness.1: For me, weightlifting is much more than just a sport: it is a discipline that teaches me consistency, rigor, and patience.
fitness.2: I like to follow my progress, adjust my programs and experiment with new training methods. It is a balance between physical, mental and lifestyle effort that brings me energy and determination every day.
